title: Geologic map of the Wateree quadrangle, Calhoun, Richland and Sumter Counties, South Carolina
citation: Shelley, D.C., 2007, Geologic map of the Wateree quadrangle, Calhoun, Richland and Sumter Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQM-36, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: OCR of a map sheet with interleaved columns. Cross section A-A' (vertical exaggeration 40) read from page image tiles: drill holes and the Devil's Elbow measured section (Padgett, 1980), with unit intervals as elevations read off the feet scale (+/-2 ft, inferred). Per the map, solid lines are holes within 0.5 km of the line and dashed lines are 0.5-2 km away (projected). One hole on the section identified only by a geotechnical source code is not recorded; 40-237 is left out (contacts too close to read). No horizontal scale, so no distances or contact points. Many references on SC geology recorded; general ones (Georgia dunes, Carolina bay geomorphology, LIDAR data sources) skipped.
